name: blanktick
description: Ask Claude how secure this PC is, and get answers read off the machine. Read-only and offline.
long_description: Blanktick is an offline security-posture scanner for Windows. This extension runs it as a local MCP server over stdio: no socket is opened and nothing on the machine is changed. Every tool is a question; Claude recommends, you decide and act. Results report what could not be checked as well as what passed, so 'could not look' is never rounded to 'fine'. Scan history (history/search/changes) is off until you set keepHistory=true in %APPDATA%\Blanktick\settings.conf.

tools.name: blanktick_scan
tools.description: Full scan: score, every finding with its fix, and the checks that could not be performed (~100 s).

tools.name: blanktick_facts
tools.description: The raw facts read off the machine, including the nulls.

tools.name: blanktick_probe_script
tools.description: The exact PowerShell Blanktick runs, so it can be read or re-run by hand.

tools.name: blanktick_coverage
tools.description: What Blanktick can and cannot check here, and why.

tools.name: blanktick_history
tools.description: Past scans from the local store: when, score, how many findings.

tools.name: blanktick_search
tools.description: Findings across stored scans, filtered by severity, rule, category or date.

tools.name: blanktick_changes
tools.description: What is new and what is gone between the two most recent scans.

tools.name: blanktick_netlog
tools.description: Review a Wireshark capture the user exported (CSV). Captures nothing.
